DEFERRED by ruling (Huayin, 2026-08-21, item 6): requires editorial/source reconciliation, not blind currentization. The CURRENT framework manual, citing The Theory of Data at v3.1 (21760008) and v4.0 (21774032) while the current record is v6.1 (22013410). The surrounding prose argues FROM the v3.1/v4.0 vocabulary, so swapping the tokens would leave the manual citing v6.1 for claims v6.1 does not make — a worse defect than the stale one, and a silent one. It belongs to a manual pass with a human reading the argument, not to this migration.

The corpus-coverage ledger (Phase 3B, 2026-08-21). It exists to name what the registry does NOT cover, so it necessarily quotes identifiers the registry does not model — five of these eight belong to no record here, and three of those five belong to no work here EITHER. That is not a leak; it is the subject. Each uncovered token is scoped by a reconciliation item to this file alone (rc-atlas-two-concepts, rc-two-great-sources-successor, rc-frameql-primer-related-identifier, rc-corpus-uncovered-works), so naming a deposit in the ledger grants it no standing anywhere else and no current-authority claim anywhere at all. Asserts no current publication fact to the public.
